title: The Keeper of the Gatecakes
kernel: A company seeks to recruit the keeper who keeps Harrowgate Pass clear in winter.

cast.name: Nenime Rootward
cast.who: an elven feeder from the Western Forests who tends a winter feeder above the pass.
cast.want: to be offered a steady place in the company in exchange for safe passage for her feeder

cast.name: Theodahad
cast.who: a beekeeper of the clearings who keeps crooked account of wax and gossip.
cast.want: to be paid in a barrel of wax

cast.name: Eileua Greyfell
cast.who: a rampart sergeant sworn to the forest pledges and quick with the charter of claims.
cast.want: to collect the forest pledge from any moved cache

situation: The company wants to recruit the person who keeps Harrowgate Pass open in winter. The lane stays clear because someone brings food to a thing at the pass. Reports last pointed to the beekeepers' clearings. The company has no outside client and plans to bring the keeper back to the fort as new hire.
goal: to recruit the keeper of the Harrowgate winter feeder so she will join the company and secure their winter supply line
arc: Travel to the beekeepers' clearings to ask who keeps Harrowgate Pass fed → yields: a torn map-scrap that names Coldwell Ryke as the wax-store that supplies the pass.
Go to Coldwell Ryke using the map-scrap and inspect the cold-store there → yields: Nenime Rootward, who will join only if the wax-cakes from the cache arrive safely at the fort.
Bring the wax-cakes to the fort to fulfill Nenime's condition and face Eileua Greyfell, the rampart sergeant who claims the forest pledge. Beat, buy, or outwit her so Nenime signs on
tensions: Eileua Greyfell enforces forest pledges and will block any removal of the wax cache
The beekeepers keep their stores close and demand wax payment for information
Nenime will not join until the cache reaches the fort unharmed
openDirections: secure the wax cache at Coldwell Ryke and move it under escort to the fort
if the wax moves, forest wardens will press legal claims that could force the company to accept local obligations
